messages:
Maria C.: FYI — alert: multiple new onboarders in EU hit a manual-sync backlog between 02:10–02:34 UTC, causing delayed tenant setup and webhook retries. Collecting affected list now. :warning:
Tom R.: copying logs now, looks like a Redis eviction storm + backpressure on the enqueue worker.
Anya O.: repro steps? can we isolate to a single shard/queue?
Tom R.: seems tied to 'onboard-enqueue-v2' queue, spikes in prefix reindex jobs. sample tail: 
```
ERROR enqueue_worker: requeue limit exceeded tenant=acct-78f, err=redis: OOM command not allowed
WARN retry_backoff: delaying tenant=acct-123 for 45s
```
Kevin S.: I'm scaling the enqueue workers x2 on eu-west, moving noncritical batch jobs to midnight window. Will monitor.
deploy-bot: Autoscaler triggered: enqueue-service eu-west increased from 3 -> 6 instances (reason: high queue length).
Lisa K.: We're drafting customer comms. Maria, do we want a single blast or segmented by impacted tenants?
Maria C.: Segment. High-touch customers first (paid early-onboarders), rest get templated note + office hours invite.
Sam P.: Quick ask: are any renewals at risk because onboarding stalled?
Lisa K.: flagged 4 renewal accounts in the impacted set; will escalate to AMs.
Kevin S.: Short-term mitigation: 1) scale up workers (done), 2) temporary rate-limit incoming reindex jobs at router, 3) enable KV caching on onboarding prefix to reduce enqueues.
Anya O.: Can we flip the throttling gate from 100->30 per minute? I can patch router now.
Tom R.: Patch applied, see router logs: 
```
INFO router: throttle set to 30rpm for path=/onboard/reindex
```
Maria C.: Draft customer note (high-touch):
"Hi <CustomerName>,
We detected a delay affecting tenant onboarding between 02:10–02:34 UTC in eu-west that may have caused slower setup and webhook retries. Our engineers scaled workers and applied throttling to prevent retries; most affected accounts are now finishing final sync. Next steps: we offered live office hours at 10:00 UTC today and a targeted retry window for your tenant. We're also issuing a one-time onboarding credit for the inconvenience. We'll follow up with an RCA within 48 hours.
If you'd like immediate help, reply and we'll prioritize your tenant"
Lisa K.: Nice. Add explicit ETA language: "expected completion within 2 hours for majority; contact us if not".
Sam P.: I'll notify the 4 renewal owners with a note and offer a 1-month free trial extension where applicable.
Kevin S.: Postmortem checklist: capture heap/eviction metrics, queue-length histogram, worker panics, and blocked syscall traces from kernel. I will create a runtime ticket.
Maria C.: Ops items for CS: 1) Send segmented emails (high-touch + templated). 2) Run office hours (Lisa) and share calendar link. 3) Prepare exec note for any CSM escalations.
Lisa K.: Drafting templated customer note now, adding repro window and link to status page + FAQ.
Tom R.: For SRE follow-up: put a guardrail to reject >3 reindex attempts per minute from same tenant and surface to logs. Also we should add an automatic fallback to background sync if foreground fails.
sre-oncall-bot: Alert cleared at 02:36 UTC (queue length back to normal).
Maria C.: Final checklist before we send: confirm affected tenant list, approve credit amounts, and have a named engineer on call for office hours.
Kevin S.: Tenant list attached to ticket #ENG-7621 (internal). Will ping when it's shared to CS.
Lisa K.: I'll send the high-touch notes first at 08:15 UTC, templated batch at 09:00 UTC. Office hours link: https://meet.redwood.ai/office-hours/03-22-10utc
Sam P.: Thx team. After comms, let's capture verbatim customer feedback in the onboarding tracker and route high-severity replies to CS-SRE bridge.
Maria C.: Agree. Closing loop: once RCAs exist, we'll append to customer thread and offer follow-up remediation if required. :white_check_mark:
